name: Digital Goods API (Play Billing in a TWA)
plain: Lets a Play Store web app sell in app items through Google Play.
meaning: Lists products and past purchases of the account inside a TWA; needs Play account.

access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Lets a Play Store web app sell in app items through Google Play.

limits.headline: Can sell in app items in a Play Store web app through Google Play
limits.user_action: You tap Buy on an in app item inside a Play Store web app.
can: Show the items for sale and their prices from Google Play
Open the Google Play payment sheet
Check which items you already own
cannot: Charge you without the Play Billing sheet
Work in Safari, Firefox, Edge or on iPhone
Work in a plain web page that is not installed from the Play Store
limits.differs: Only Android Chrome inside a Play Store app (a TWA) supports it. iPhone has nothing like it for web apps.

story.what_it_is: A Play Store web app can sell items and subscriptions through Google Play.

marketing.name: Digital Goods API
marketing.pitch: Chrome's docs explain how Trusted Web Activity apps can take payments with Play Billing.

story.for_you: You buy a subscription in an Android app that is secretly a website, and Google Play handles the payment and bill.
story.for_makers: Makers who put a web app on the Play Store must use Play Billing for digital goods. This API lets the web code do it without a separate native app.

use_cases.example: A casual web game sold on Google Play adds coins and removes ads with in app purchases.
A news PWA sells monthly subscriptions through Play.
A music practice app sells premium lessons.
A language learning PWA sells a yearly plan.
A notes app unlocks pro features with a one time purchase.
A free app sells 'remove ads' as a one time item.

technical_bounds: Only inside a TWA published on Google Play
Play refunds unacknowledged purchases after 3 days
Requires Play Developer and Google Payments accounts and Digital Asset Links

history.change: Digital Goods API on Android and ChromeOS in a TWA
